ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 12:88 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white annular rings and punctate spots across both lobes; dense, high-intensity textured clusters concentrated on the extreme lateral tips (0,y and max_x,y coordinates).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 45-55 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 25 pixels along the entire trailing boundary, distinct from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave upward sweep from the median notch to the lateral tips, characterized by a smooth curve that increases in slope toward the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) distributed across the dark field of both lobes, representing previous colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Minimal visible linear disruptions; faint, short unaligned light-colored streaks are detectable on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy accumulation of high-relief, textured white/tan calcified masses (barnacles) on the leading edges and extreme tips of both lobes; extensive circular depigmentation throughout.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent dark raised protrusion (tubercle) located on the ventral midline approximately 50 pixels below the vertex of the median notch.
